findings.message: Resolved in fix round 1: assertPmBinding now detects current format and rejects a missing or null shared story binding, while preserving null bindings for standalone and legacy runs. The regression explicitly nulls an active current run binding and proves check, gate, review, verify and finish all fail without changing the stored revision.

Resolved in fix round 1: same-owner claim resumption now requires a clean checkout on the plan integration branch before returning the existing binding and counters. Regressions reject dirty integration and story-branch resumes, accept the clean integration resume, and retain runtime start from the claimed story branch.

summary: Independent re-review verified both T03 authority corrections and the complete current approval, claim, runtime binding, counter, default-format and legacy compatibility scope. Both prior majors are resolved, no new blocking finding remains, and full coordinator gates passed at the corrected exact snapshot.
